title: Audio Processing Utilities
summary: This module provides core utilities for processing audio data, including base classes for audio tokenizers and a number normalizer for speech-to-text applications.

nodes.label: PreTrainedAudioTokenizerBase
nodes.title: PreTrainedAudioTokenizerBase
nodes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for audio tokenizers, including methods for encoding raw audio into discrete codebooks and decoding back to raw audio.

nodes.label: EnglishNumberNormalizer
nodes.title: EnglishNumberNormalizer
nodes.description: A utility class for converting numerical values and currency symbols within English text into their spelled-out word forms, useful for speech synthesis and processing.

groups.label: Audio Tokenization
groups.title: Audio Tokenization
groups.description: Defines the foundational interface for handling audio tokenization processes, including encoding and decoding audio data.

groups.label: Text Normalization
groups.title: Text Normalization for Speech
groups.description: Provides utilities for normalizing numerical and symbolic text into spoken word forms, primarily for speech generation and understanding systems.
